title: Expressing Academic Strengths: Darse bien and Costar

sections.content:
Spanish has wonderful idiomatic verbs to describe how easily you learn or master a subject:

1. Darse bien / mal (to be good / bad at):
• 'Se me dan bien los idiomas.' (Languages come easily to me / I'm good at languages.)
• 'Se me dan mal las matemáticas.' (I'm bad at math.)

2. Costar (to find difficult / take effort):
• 'Me cuesta entender la gramática.' (I find grammar difficult.)

sections.title: Subject Aptitude Phrases
rows: Se me dan bien las ciencias.

items.spanish: A Carlos se le da muy bien la historia contemporánea.
items.english: Carlos is very good at contemporary history.

items.spanish: A Meg le cuesta un poco la pronunciación en español.
items.english: Meg finds Spanish pronunciation a bit difficult.
